sections.note: [presentation] stack of 15 uniform 60px question rows -> FAQ accordion

proposed_rules.trigger: A [2x1] 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA heading + link row appears as a separate top-level row (rc2) below the main content wrapper on every page captured.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a site-wide footer fragment/CTA, not per-page default-content or block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/position recurs across unrelated page templates (this dedicated FAQ page has almost no other content). Alternatives considered: per-page default-content (rejected, duplicative across all pages).

provenance.evidence: C62 rc2 identical to C60/C61 rc2

notes: A dedicated single-purpose FAQ page: hero + one large accordion block (15 rows), no other components; the existing faq-accordion-block rule fully covers it.
